title: SZL Beacon Reality Event
description: One signed-style event of the A11oy Beacon REALITY PROTOCOL. Reference schema for the reference implementation (szl-beacon). Zero physical units exist; this schema describes protocol software records only. Every event carries exactly one evidence label; an event without a label is a protocol violation.

event_id.description: sha256 hex digest of the canonical body (all fields except event_id). Canonical form in this reference implementation: JSON, sorted keys, no whitespace, UTF-8. NOT RFC 8785; production canonicalizes via szl-receipts.

seq.description: Monotonic position in the local append-only log. Genesis is 0.

prev.description: Digest of the previous event; null exactly when seq is 0.

state_from.description: Protocol state the transition leaves; null at genesis.

state_to.description: Protocol state the transition enters. Non-standard values (e.g. RC1, SAFE_STATE) are used by node-level events outside the transaction spine.

kind.description: human | operator | node | sensor | machine | peer. kind=machine is HARD-TYPED: the event's label must be MACHINE_INFERENCE.

evidence_refs.description: Content digests of the evidence this event relies on. WITNESS events must carry the witness's own evidence ref.

label.description: REQUIRED evidence label. Machine-originated content is hard-typed MACHINE_INFERENCE and is never rendered as official authority.
